data.why: The repository ships a pre-built SQLite database (data/pankegg.db) generated from the project's own CheckM2/Sourmash/EggNOG test data; the app loads it directly at startup, so there is nothing for the browser to upload.

goals: Browse all metagenome-assembled genome bins across samples and check their CheckM2 completeness and contamination quality
Filter bins by taxonomy, sample, or GTDB quality threshold to find well-assembled genomes of interest
Inspect KEGG pathway (map) completeness for a bin or sample to assess its metabolic potential
Look up a specific KEGG ortholog (KO) and see which bins and samples contain it
Compare two samples side by side (pathway heatmap, bin-quality scatterplot, PCA, shared/unique pathways)
Compare two bins directly for shared versus unique metabolic pathways

review.summary: The tree covers what PanKEGG is for: screening genomes by quality and taxonomy, checking how complete KEGG pathways are, tracing a gene function, and comparing samples and genomes. Every screen I sampled matches its node. It needs fixes before filing: the 'shared/unique pathways' wording doesn't match the code, two features bundle separate components, a few README-named uses are missing, and six tasks plus three features were never confirmed by the second agent.
